newsitem.title: USA: Cooper Cos increases fy '96 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Cooper Cos increases fy '96 estimates.

text.p: The Cooper Companies Inc said Tuesday that, buoyed by its third-quarter results, it has increased its earnings estimates for the 1996 fiscal year to between $1.30 and $1.35 per share.
That's an increase over the company's last estimate of about $1 per share, said David Frank, a spokesman for the company.
The latest estimate comes as the company releases its third quarter results, showing an increase in earnings to $0.40 per share compared with $0.24 per share in the third quarter in 1995.
Cooper President and Chief Executive Thomas Bender said in a statement that the company plans to pursue further acquisitions "that complement our strategy."
The Cooper Companies Inc and its subsidiaries develop, manufacture and market specialty healthcare products and services.
